featureTitle: A little more room to understand.
features: Each follow-up anchors to a passage in its source answer. Explore deeper or return to that passage.

Conversations and annotations stay on your device. Workspace backups and HTML learning exports serve different purposes.

guideIntro: Prepare a working model API account, then try a topic without sensitive information.
guideSteps: Choose the installer and verify its source and SHA-256. If WebView2 is missing, install it from Microsoft. Preserve your existing workspace; do not overwrite it with example data.

Go to Settings → Models & connection. Add a provider, API endpoint, key and model. Keys are stored in the system vault. Connection checks do not automatically send inference requests; use the provider's official usage page when quota is unavailable.
Enter a learning topic and send. By default the main thread includes its own history, without follow-ups. Actual context remains subject to the context budget and provider limits.
Select a passage and ask more
Select text or an equation to create a branch. By default it uses the snapshot through the source answer and that branch's history, without sibling branches, later main-thread turns or private notes.

Open Preview context to choose the scope. Main conversations and follow-ups remember selections separately; new history is not automatically added to a saved selection. Restore defaults if needed and inspect the actual request beside its answer.

Add private notes and export notes or HTML maps. Export model-organized notes before closing. Full workspace backups restore original conversations, unlike learning exports; they do not contain vault credentials.
faqTitle: A few things before you start
faq: The current client is a free beta. API quotas, prices and terms are set by your model provider; the download includes no model credits.
Does every model support images, files and voice?

No. Images require a vision-capable model. Uploading a file does not mean the model can read it; direct raw-document use with DeepSeek is not guaranteed. Voice requires a transcription-capable API connection in Models & connection. Arbitrary chat APIs are not guaranteed to support transcription.

It limits the scale of historical text in a request by characters, not your provider balance or an exact token quota. History may be shortened or omitted above this limit; inspect the actual request receipt.

Whole conversations remain in the recycle bin for 24 hours and are cleared on the next launch after expiry. Restore them before cleanup, or confirm immediate deletion. Individual answer deletion does not use the conversation recycle bin.
Does my content leave my device?
Local storage does not make model requests offline. Sending transmits your selected context, applicable attachments or transcription audio to the configured service. Check that service's data policy.
Can I use a ChatGPT subscription or another platform?
The initial public beta guide focuses on your own API access. It makes no promise about ChatGPT subscription authorization or third-party distribution. Only Windows x64 is currently delivered.
What if downloading is slow or fails?

Downloads are hosted on GitHub Releases and depend on your network. Retry from the release page, then verify the full file. Report your OS, network type and error time without sending keys or private chats.

privacyIntro: Effective October 17, 2026. This notice separately describes website visits and the ChatNote application. It covers implemented data flows, without promising encryption, sync, or third-party deletion capabilities that are not available.
privacySections: GitHub Pages hosts this website; GitHub Releases distributes installers. GitHub records visitor IP addresses for security, including for signed-out visitors; its logging, retention and processing follow GitHub’s privacy policy. The application checks a public version file and downloads signed updates from GitHub. Hosting providers receive ordinary network information such as IP addresses, without chats, notes or credentials.

Language is selected through page URLs. Selections in interface illustrations stay only in the current page. There are no accounts, and the website collects no chats or API keys. Copy buttons write only the public text you deliberately select to the clipboard.

Conversations, revisions, annotation anchors, notes, drafts, reading positions and preferences are saved in your local workspace. Attachments are also stored locally. No developer-hosted cloud sync is offered, and database encryption is not promised. Protect your device and backups.

API keys and login credentials are stored in the system vault. Sending transmits selected context and applicable attachments to your configured model service; transcription sends recorded audio to your selected transcription service. Private notes are not automatically included.

Model, transcription, authentication, usage pages and download hosting are third-party services that may process content, accounts and network data. Their own policies and terms apply. ChatNote cannot promise their non-retention or deletion.

Whole conversations remain in the recycle bin for 24 hours, then are cleared on the next launch after expiry. Restore before cleanup or confirm permanent deletion. Cleanup covers related recovery records and unshared attachments. It does not promise secure disk erasure; exported files and third-party copies need separate management.

You manage your backups and exports, which may contain private content but do not contain system-vault keys. Contact details, descriptions and screenshots you send to the developer are used for communication and feedback handling. Do not send secrets or sensitive original content; contact the developer to request deletion of submitted feedback.

Choose services, preview context, stop requests, manage the recycle bin and back up. Stopping locally does not retract data already received by a third party. For privacy questions, contact 529023573@qq.com or Xiaohongshu ID 1006863642. Updates to this policy will show their date.

testingSteps: Record Windows version, network type and client version; verify the downloaded file checksum.
Install on a fresh computer or with a backed-up workspace. Check startup and preservation of existing data.

Export notes and an HTML map, then restart to check retained conversations and private notes.
Visit and download over both Wi-Fi and mobile data. Record failure times and messages.

analyticsPrivacy: This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to understand page views, referral sources, device categories and page performance. The developer views statistics in the authenticated dashboard; no counters appear on the website. The production website loads Cloudflare’s analytics script and sends visit and performance data to Cloudflare. It uses no analytics cookies and collects no chats, notes, API keys or application usage records. Local previews do not enable analytics. This website also respects browser Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals. Network restrictions and blockers can cause undercounting. Installer download figures use GitHub’s public release asset counters; they do not represent unique users or successful installations.
